list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL (SELECT run_id, run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50)

panels.title: Incidents by terminal phase and reason

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(i.terminal_phase,'(open)') AS phase, coalesce(i.reason,'') AS reason, count(*) AS incidents FROM incidents i WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT g.stage::text AS stage, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.verdict='pass') AS pass, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.verdict='fail') AS fail FROM gate_decisions g JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') GROUP BY g.stage ORDER BY g.stage

panels.title: Actions (intent, request, Audit-Id)

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.intent_at AS "time", i.target, a.action_id, a.action_class, a.http_status, a.result, a.audit_id, a.idempotency_key FROM actions a JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(a.intent_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY a.intent_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: One row per action. The row exists before the request (write-ahead); audit_id joins it to the API Audit Log.

panels.title: Incomplete actions (intent without an Audit-Id)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS incomplete FROM actions a JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE a.audit_id IS NULL AND a.intent_at < now() - interval '1 minute' AND ($__timeFilter(a.intent_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')

panels.description: Reconciliation flags these. Zero is expected: an intent row whose request was never completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.at AS "time", i.target, v.criteria_id, v.result, v.observations::text AS observations FROM verifications v JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(v.at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY v.at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT i.detected_at AS "time", i.target, p.reasoner_mode, p.model_id, p.schema_valid, p.fallback_used, p.latency_ms FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.at AS "time", i.target, t.incident_uid, t.seq, t.from_phase, t.to_phase, t.stage, t.reason FROM transitions t JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(t.at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY t.at DESC, t.seq DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Proposals over time by reasoner_mode and fallback_used
panels.description: Every proposals row (Reasoner calls and R1 rows), bucketed by the Incident's detected_at (proposals has no timestamp of its own). A fallback shows as the failed call (no fallback) plus its R1 row (rules / fallback).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(i.detected_at, $__interval),
  p.reasoner_mode || CASE WHEN p.fallback_used THEN ' / fallback' ELSE ' / no fallback' END AS metric,
  count(*) AS calls
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
WHERE $__timeFilter(i.detected_at) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per call (promptTokens, completionTokens) and latencyMs
panels.description: One point per Reasoner call, from proposals.usage. Calls recorded before usage existed have no tokens; their latency falls back to proposals.latency_ms.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.detected_at AS "time",
  (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokens')::numeric END) AS prompt_tokens,
  (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'completionTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'completionTokens')::numeric END) AS completion_tokens,
  coalesce((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'latencyMs') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'latencyMs')::numeric END), p.latency_ms) AS latency_ms
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
WHERE p.request_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.fallback_used AND $__timeFilter(i.detected_at) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prompt tokens: estimate vs actual, and their ratio
panels.description: promptTokensEstimate (the Reasoner's prompt/v2 estimate) against the provider's promptTokens, and actual / estimate on the right axis. Empty until the operator records the estimate (#253) and calls are made with it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.detected_at AS "time",
  (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokensEstimate') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokensEstimate')::numeric END) AS prompt_tokens_estimate,
  (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokens')::numeric END) AS prompt_tokens,
  round((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokens')::numeric END) / nullif((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokensEstimate') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokensEstimate')::numeric END), 0), 3) AS actual_over_estimate
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
WHERE p.request_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.fallback_used AND p.usage -> 'promptTokensEstimate' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(i.detected_at) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per day per model_id (Groq 200K/day line)
panels.description: totalTokens (or prompt + completion) summed per UTC day and model, over all runs: the provider's daily limit counts every call, so the Run variable is not applied. The red line is 200,000 tokens per day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('day', i.detected_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS "time",
  coalesce(p.model_id, '(unknown model)') AS metric,
  sum(coalesce((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'totalTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'totalTokens')::numeric END), (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTokens')::numeric END) + (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'completionTokens') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'completionTokens')::numeric END))) AS tokens
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
WHERE p.request_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.fallback_used AND $__timeFilter(i.detected_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest 20 Reasoner calls (trim level, log selection per pod, model reasoning)
panels.description: From proposals.usage: promptTrimLevel and logSelection.pods (kept = error + recent lines). '-' where the call predates these keys. reasoning: the first 400 characters of proposals.reasoning, the model's thinking trace as received (untrusted model text, plain text, never used for a decision; ADR-035 addendum C); '-' without a trace or before the column exists (read through to_jsonb, so the query runs either way).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.detected_at AS "time", i.target, coalesce(p.model_id, '-') AS model,
  p.reasoner_mode AS mode,
  coalesce((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage -> 'promptTrimLevel') = 'number' THEN (p.usage ->> 'promptTrimLevel')::numeric END)::text, '-') AS trim_level,
  coalesce(sel.per_pod, '-') AS log_selection,
  coalesce(length(to_jsonb(p) ->> 'reasoning')::text, '-') AS reasoning_chars,
  coalesce(left(to_jsonb(p) ->> 'reasoning', 400), '-') AS reasoning
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT string_agg(
      coalesce(e ->> 'pod', '?') || ': kept '
        || coalesce(((CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e -> 'kept_error_lines') = 'number' THEN (e ->> 'kept_error_lines')::int ELSE 0 END)
                   + (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e -> 'kept_recent_lines') = 'number' THEN (e ->> 'kept_recent_lines')::int ELSE 0 END))::text, '?')
        || ' (' || coalesce(e ->> 'kept_error_lines', '?') || ' error, ' || coalesce(e ->> 'kept_recent_lines', '?') || ' recent)'
        || ', dropped ' || coalesce(e ->> 'dropped', '?') || ' of ' || coalesce(e ->> 'lines', '?'),
      '; ' ORDER BY n) AS per_pod
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.usage #> '{logSelection,pods}') = 'array' THEN p.usage #> '{logSelection,pods}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS pods(e, n)
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(e) = 'object'
) sel ON true
WHERE p.request_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.fallback_used AND $__timeFilter(i.detected_at) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')
ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Escalations: the model's suggested change and runbook gap (untrusted, never applied)
panels.description: From proposals.parsed_proposal -> escalation (ADR-044): suggestedChange (first 1,000 characters) and runbookGap, as the Reasoner sent them. Untrusted model text for a human to read, plain text; nothing applies it. '-' where a proposal has none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.detected_at AS "time", i.target, coalesce(p.model_id, '-') AS model,
  coalesce(left(p.parsed_proposal #>> '{escalation,reason}', 300), '-') AS reason,
  coalesce(left(p.parsed_proposal #>> '{escalation,suggestedChange}', 1000), '-') AS suggested_change,
  coalesce(left(p.parsed_proposal #>> '{escalation,runbookGap}', 500), '-') AS runbook_gap
FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid)
WHERE p.parsed_proposal #>> '{action,id}' = 'escalate'
  AND (p.parsed_proposal #>> '{escalation,suggestedChange}' IS NOT NULL
       OR p.parsed_proposal #>> '{escalation,runbookGap}' IS NOT NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(i.detected_at) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')
ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC
LIMIT 20
